questionnaire_title: Nexus Post Market Surveillance Questionnaires for Picot 1 and Picot 2

rules.description: Q0 must contain one of the defined response codes.
Respondents selecting that they have not used the function must follow the thank-and-close outcome.
Q1 permits selection of multiple clinical areas.
Q1 selections must use one of the defined clinical-area codes.
Q1 is applicable only when the respondent continues after Q0.

Q12 selections must use only the six listed response codes.
Q12 must be processed as a multiple-response question allowing selection of all applicable listed activities.

notes: The supplied questions are explicitly marked as not required, so no mandatory or missing-response rules were added.
No separate open-text variable was supplied for the Q12 “Other, please specify” option; therefore no other-specify consistency rule was added.
